items.unit: GBP per autoclave moulding facility (ex VAT)
items.basis: UK contract award: University of Bristol, 'autoclave moulding facility', contractor ASC Process Systems, total value GBP 333,765 excluding VAT, 2 tenders received, contract start 28 Jul 2023. Spec in the notice: thermoset work to 250 C and thermoplastic research to 400 C. The Bristol Composites Institute's ASC unit is described elsewhere as an 'Econoclave EC1Mx1.5m' (model name suggests ~1 m dia x 1.5 m long)
items.scope: Autoclave + controls as a 'facility' (installation likely included, not itemised). Smaller vessel (~1.0 m x 1.5 m) than the library's 1.2 m x 3 m, but a 400 C / thermoplastic rating, which costs more than a 200 C production vessel. Nearest standard model priced; no pressure stated in the snippet.
items.notes: Pages not opened (find-tender.service.gov.uk does not resolve from this session; WebFetch ENOTFOUND). Value, date and spec are as the search result quoted them; the EC1Mx1.5m identification comes from a separate Composites UK article and is an inference that it is the same unit. Book: annualDepreciation 60,720 x 10 = GBP 607k; financeCost 7,500 / 0.02 = GBP 375k. With this award (GBP 334k for a 400 C research vessel) and the carried QUB estimate (GBP 730k for a 3 m x 6 m vessel, ~10x the volume), the book's depreciation basis (~GBP 0.6m) looks HIGH for a 1.2 m x 3 m 200 C vessel; the finance basis (~GBP 0.375m) is consistent.

notes: 18 of 18 web searches used. WebFetch fails for find-tender.service.gov.uk (ENOTFOUND: host outside this session's allowed network), so every figure is as the search result quoted it for that URL and is marked verify: true.

Book pattern: for all 22 machines annualDepreciation x 10 is ~1.6x financeCost / 0.02 (e.g. imm-100t 141.7k v 87.5k), i.e. the depreciation implies a ~6-year write-off of the finance-basis capex. The one outlier is mach-afp-atl (GBP 4.25m v GBP 1.2m, 3.5x) - internally inconsistent.

Confident book issues: (1) autoclave-1200mm depreciation basis (~GBP 0.61m) is high v a GBP 334k award for a 400 C 1 m x 1.5 m vessel and a GBP 730k estimate for a 3 m x 6 m vessel; (2) mach-afp-atl depreciation and finance bases disagree 3.5x; (3) imm-500t finance basis (GBP 312.5k) is low for a European make (Wittmann 500 t GBP 500k) but high for a Chinese one (Borche 600 t > GBP 130k) - the book should state which make it prices.

Not found: rotational moulding (3 types), thermoforming (4 types), imm-100t / imm-200t by size, EBM (2), SBM 2-stage, extrusion lines (3), HP-RTM, standard composite cure oven. Marketplace and used listings were seen and deliberately not recorded.
